summary: Iteration 14 — end-to-end testing of (1) new Expense claims feature, (2) admin dashboard KioskLinkCard, and (3) Face enrollment fix. All 24 new backend tests pass. All frontend flows verified: employee submit + receipt view, admin approve + mark-reimbursed, sidebar/topnav links, KioskLinkCard with QR+URL+toggle+copy+rotate+open, and Face enrollment models loading successfully (no error overlay) with live video ready.

issues: Upcoming meetings widget shows 'INVALID DATE / NaN' for TEST_garbage_* meetings — invalid date data in DB. Console error: 'Received NaN for the %s attribute'. Not part of this iteration but recommend either filtering out invalid dates or defensively rendering '—'.

critical_code_review_comments: routes/expenses.py: clean, correctly uses async/await, strips _id, RBAC via require_roles is consistent, receipt size guard (5MB) enforced before writing. Manager routing via employee.manager_id → user_id resolution works and populated for maya→alex as spec'd.

MyExpenses.jsx / Expenses.jsx: proper loading of categories, defensive Promise.all for parallel data fetch, correct data-testids on every interactive element (expense-row-<id>, view-receipt-<id>, approve-expense-<id>, pay-expense-<id>, decision-dialog, decision-submit, tab-<status>, etc.). Uses toast for success/error. Well factored.

KioskLinkCard.jsx: gracefully handles 'no token yet' → shows Generate CTA (data-testid=kiosk-card-generate) and 'token exists' → shows QR + URL + Copy/Open/Rotate + toggle. Toggle disabled when no token (prevents 400). Uses qrcode.react QRCodeSVG (already in package.json). Good separation.

useFaceCapture.js: humangl backend with wasmPath pointing to jsdelivr CDN — this is the actual fix for the previous white-screen bug. Load path is now: (a) getUserMedia FIRST for fast permission failure, (b) then Human import + h.load() with humangl → fallback to wasm on failure. Retry callback correctly resets state and re-triggers effect via retryTick.

FaceEnroll.jsx: retry UI + data-testid='face-enroll-error' + data-testid='face-enroll-retry' correctly conditional on `error && !loadingModels`. Live status badges (Face/Real/Live) render only when ready && !error && !loadingModels — no chance of empty-frame overlay.

Minor nit: expenses.py POST /expenses currently allows currency to be any 3-8 char string (uppercased). Consider validating against a whitelist (INR/USD/EUR/…) in a future iteration; today an employee could submit currency='ZZZ'. Not blocking.

success_rate.frontend: 100% (all flows verified — employee submit+receipt, admin approve+reimburse, kiosk card, face enrollment)
